facts.text: Set up a company in a sandbox first so users can practice before using production.
Validate configuration questionnaire by checking that text strings are not in date fields and reviewing regional format consistency.
Import customer data from Excel or rapidstart file using Configuration Worksheet or Configuration Package page.
Configuration packages are not for production companies already in use; use XMLport for large data imports in production instead.
Mapping can be set for individual fields or derived from related table primary keys, with direct field mapping taking priority.
